Home News Arts and Culture Business Sports Opinion Research Live TV/Radio Media Elections Dark Mode Dark mode --> Events | National | Regional Rap battle, more thrills mark final day of Republic Bank–JoyNews Habitat Fair in Ho Source : Judy Yayra Avanu 18 October 2026 6:04pm Audio By Carbonatix
The Ho edition of the Republic Bank–JoyNews Habitat Fair has come to a close, ending three days of exhibitions, public engagement and activities connecting visitors with businesses in the housing and construction sectors.
One of the highlights of the final day on Sunday, October 18, was a rap battle involving some participating institutions, which took turns rapping to a selected beat to introduce their organisations and highlight the products and services they offer.
The contest brought a different kind of energy to the grounds, as exhibitors cheered one another on and joined in the excitement.
At the end of the competition, Rhoyak Ventures emerged winners, while DoorMasters placed second. The two institutions received souvenirs from some of the exhibitors in recognition of their performances.
Beyond the entertainment, visitors continued to make their way to the Ho Sports Stadium to explore the exhibition stands, interact with exhibitors and seek information on products and services related to housing, construction and home improvement.
Participating businesses showcased a range of offerings, including building materials, property development, roofing systems, water storage solutions and home security. The fair provided visitors with an opportunity to engage directly with industry players and learn more about available options for their housing needs.
The three-day event, which began on Friday, October 16, brought together businesses and members of the public, with cultural entertainment and activities for children also forming part of the experience.
With the rap battle providing a lively finish to the final day, the Republic Bank–JoyNews Habitat Fair has now concluded its Ho edition, bringing this chapter of the exhibition to a close.
